Dispositions come from docs/plans/2026-09-18-shadcn-reset/extras.md (66 rows, MK 2026-09-18); hooks and internal parts are not components and are recorded here with their reason.

data-table-parts.rationale: CORRECTED from RETIRE to KEEP by MK on 2026-09-18, executed in Batch 7b. The consumer story extras.md named (shadcn's data-table guide + dashboard-01) is right for a consumer, but the module is 375 lines that BOTH `data-grid` and `data-list` — both keepers — import the same ten symbols from, so retiring it would either duplicate them into two files (the drift the module's own header says it exists to stop) or need a different disposition. It stays ONE shared module. It is off the consumer-facing components nav, the way `geo-data` and `drag-item` are handled: installed as a dependency of the two components that need it, documented where they are documented, not offered as something to pick from a list.

date-picker.rationale: Batch 7b rebuilt it on upstream `calendar`: the grid, the day button, the captions and the nav are imported from `@/components/ui/calendar`, and this module is the Popover/Button composition plus `Intl` formatting and the preset rails. `react-day-picker` survives here as TYPES (`DateRange`, `Matcher`, `DayButton`) plus its two matcher EVALUATORS (`dateMatchModifiers`, `rangeContainsModifiers`), which the preset gate calls so a preset obeys exactly the policy the grid enforces; re-deriving Matcher evaluation is the drift the gate exists to prevent, so that import stayed. The one DOM part here is `PopoverDayButton`, which WRAPS upstream's `CalendarDayButton` (never copies it) to focus with `preventScroll` — see its note and `date-picker.test.tsx`'s below-the-fold regression, which fails without it.

table-scroll-region.source: internal part of table; not listed in extras.md. Batch 5 reset `table` onto upstream's file, which wraps itself in its own `data-slot="table-container"` overflow div, so NOTHING imports this module any more — it ships inside the `@vegastack/table` item and is re-exported by nobody. BATCH 7a DECIDED TO KEEP IT, and the reason is mechanical rather than a preference: A11Y-6's second clause is conditional on a LIVE MEASUREMENT (`useOverflow`, a React hook), so putting it on upstream's container re-adds `'use client'` to `table.tsx` and drags every purely-presentational Table part out of the server tree — which is exactly the API-16 hunk `table.patch` already carries, in the opposite direction. The only hook-free alternative, an unconditional `tabIndex={0}` plus `role="region"`, is a DIFFERENT and worse behaviour: a table that fits gains a tab stop, and a page with several tables publishes several indistinguishable landmarks. Composing this file from upstream's `Table` instead would change upstream's component signature (new `label`/`containerClassName` props) and replace its own `<div>` — a structural rewrite, which the batch was told not to make. So the gap stays pinned by `data-list.test.tsx`'s `a wide DataList overflows in upstream's container, which is NOT yet a tab stop`, and this module stays available for the Batch 7b/7c rebuild of `data-list`/`data-grid` to adopt. NEEDS MK.
